title: Which Witch?
description: A 2D rhythm/dating-sim game with a unique mix of storytelling and head-bopping music. Still in development, originally made in a game jam.

title: Closed Eyes
description: A narrative-driven newspaper-editing game where spinning the story to the public and managing differing factions affect the future of a noir city.

title: Pluto
description: A single player arcade-style game focused heavily on that authentic arcade machine feel. A randomly generated maze with some secret easter eggs and a hidden lore.

title: Wraithborne
description: An unreleased card game centered around strategic card usage mixed with the match influencing the world around it, including creatures, spells, environmentals, and more.

title: Phoenix
description: A 3D narrative-adventure horror game with a focus on atmospheric storytelling and strong narrative beats.
